title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
abstract: arXiv:2610.22016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from h

translated_title: 足够接近实则相去甚远：KV缓存中的保真度-可用性解耦
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统通过文本进行通信，这种方式是有损且浪费的：发送方丢弃了自己已经完成的阅读理解。越来越多的文献转而传输KV缓存——这种阅读成果的天然载体。我们研究了这一思路中最具吸引力的形式：两个模型均保持冻结，直接将发送方的缓存替换给读取方使用，不进行任何训练。然而这种方法行不通，且障碍来自读取方本身。一个冻结的Transformer只能读取与自己原本会生成的缓存足够接近的缓存，我们将这一区域称为其“可容忍集”。我们证明，与该缓存的几何相似性并不能预测读取方能否使用某个替代缓存，且失败并非渐进式的，因此看似更“保真”的替代品并非如表面那样有效。我们用竞争性注意力解释了这一现象。在实验中，我们针对两个测量锚点测试了八种多样化的替换方法：一个无信息缓存基线，以及读取方自身从（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 论文揭示了冻结的多智能体LLM系统中直接替换发送方KV缓存不可行的根本原因——读取方只能接受其自身“可容忍集”内的缓存，几何保真度与可用性相互解耦且失败并非渐进式，这一现象可由竞争性注意力机制解释。
en_tdlr: Directly substituting the sender's KV cache for a frozen reader's cache fails because the reader only accepts caches within its own "tolerable set"; geometric fidelity does not predict consumability, and this non-gradual failure is explained by competitive attention.
